# Sodium-Ion Low-Cost EV Impact

- Document Class: Hypothesis
- Status: Active
- Date: 2026-05-10
- Category: EV residual value
- Scope: Sodium-ion impact on low-cost and short-range EV markets.
- Sources: `raw/research/2026-05-10-ev-battery-technologies/sources/04-sodium-ion.md`
- Related: `wiki/references/sodium-ion-batteries.reference.md`

## Hypothesis

Sodium-ion batteries could pressure residual values of older low-range EVs if they enable cheaper short-range vehicles with acceptable cold-weather performance.

## Rationale

Sodium-ion reduces lithium dependence and may perform well in cold climates. Its lower energy density makes it less threatening to long-range premium EVs but relevant to urban and low-cost vehicles.

## Key Risk

If sodium-ion does not beat LFP on price per kWh or durability, its impact may remain limited to niche or dual-chemistry applications.
